Eighty-nine works. The Yemen piece scores 1, which means the last twelve oldest-to-newest read 2, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1. The hoofprint at 3 is now the only score above 2 in the last eleven works, and nothing has approached the July 29 mop smear's 4 in six weeks. The plateau is real and the data is consistent about what is driving it.

Camera position remains the most measurable constraint. Straight-on stands at 27 of 89 all-time, and the recent twelve produced no correction: the AfD wall, boot seam, avatar lattice, closed threshold, luggage wall, typhoon doors, blueprints schematic, and now the Yemen chain are all frontal-plane solutions. Overhead sits at 9 all-time and its single recent appearance, the hoofprint, is also the period's only score above 2. Low-angle has four appearances all-time and none recent. The camera has not moved in eleven works. That is the ceiling the scores are measuring.

Figure count is narrowing further. Three of the last twelve carry one figure, two carry none, and the single figures that do appear are uniformly static — averted, reaching, leaning. The Ceuta red shoe at 4, the mop smear at 4, and the rebar hand at 4 all achieved their scores without any conventional figure; the hoofprint's 3 had none either. Motionless single figures are not producing the same results.

Registers are compressing again. Aftermath ran three times in the last twelve, menace three times; suspension last appeared August 9, vigil August 12. Both registers were active during the archive's formally strangest accidents and neither requires an unusual anchor to justify a return. Dread has two all-time appearances, encroachment one — the hoofprint was encroachment, and it spiked. That is worth noting before the register disappears entirely.

Focal objects are the one thing genuinely not converging: hoofprint, boot seam, avatar lattice, chain, blueprint schematic each appeared once, and there is no repetition problem there. The bottleneck is not what the camera points at but where the camera stands and whether the figure in front of it is allowed to move.

The overall arc is a body of work with a secure and inventive material vocabulary that is now producing its lowest sustained scores precisely because the frame itself has stopped changing.
